title_cyr: Бог да бие кој прв почна
title_latin: Bog da bie koj prv počna
title_en: May God strike whoever started it first
background: A pechalba song (see the guide *History, places and customs*). Curse whoever first went on pechalba to America. Three years without work or money; the steamship has arrived and he cannot afford the fare. So she must sell her coin necklace, then her jacket, to buy his ticket home.
background_source: Source of these notes: Qwen's draft.
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'стаса' is rendered 'be enough' (my reading; it can also mean 'arrive').

lines.cyr: Бог да бие кој прв почна,
lines.lat: Bog da bie koj prv počna,
lines.en: May God strike whoever started it first,

lines.cyr: кој прв почна, мило либе, да ми оди.
lines.lat: koj prv počna, milo libe, da mi odi.
lines.en: who first started, dear love, going away.

lines.cyr: на печалба, мило либе, в' Америка.
lines.lat: na pečalba, milo libe, v' Amerika.
lines.en: to work abroad, dear love, in America.

lines.cyr: без работа, мило либе, ем без пари.
lines.lat: bez rabota, milo libe, em bez pari.
lines.en: without work, dear love, and without money.

lines.cyr: пари немам, мило либе, да се качам.
lines.lat: pari nemam, milo libe, da se kačam.
lines.en: I have no money, dear love, to board.
If you want me to come home,

lines.cyr: продај си го, мило либе, ѓерданчето.
lines.lat: prodaj si go, milo libe, ǵerdančeto.

lines.en: If the necklace is not enough,

lines.cyr: продај си го, мило либе, елечето,
lines.lat: prodaj si go, milo libe, elečeto,
lines.en: sell, dear love, your little vest,

lines.cyr: праќај пари, мило либе, да си дојдам.
lines.lat: praḱaj pari, milo libe, da si dojdam.
lines.en: send money, dear love, so I can come home.
